page_summary: This page discusses the critical role of ports in international trade and their increasing recognition as critical infrastructure due to digitalization. It highlights the shift from manual operations to interconnected digital systems, which enhances efficiency but also increases cyber risks. The World Economic Forum's 2026 Risk Perception Survey identifies cyber insecurity as a significant global threat, particularly in the maritime sector, where disruptions can have cascading effects on supply chains.
